question: Does NovaCart provide free lifetime warranty coverage for every product, including accidental damage?
draft:
NovaCart Support Playbook: Product & Warranty Category: Product & Warranty | Document ID: SOP-OPS-PW-03 | Version: 2026.4 | Scope: Tier 1-3 Support Section 1: Warranty Verification, Coverage Scope & Brand Partnerships 1.1 Objective: This document codifies technical diagnostics, Dead-On-Arrival (DOA) classifications, warranty entitlements, and Authorized Service Center (ASC) escalation protocols across all retail merchandise on NovaCart.

 NovaCare Extended Protection: Optional supplemental warranty purchased during checkout covering accidental liquid damage, drop damage, and power surge failures for up to 36 months.

1.2 Multi-Tiered Warranty Structure  NovaCart 30-Day Platform Assurance: Covers manufacturing defects, latent hardware malfunctions, and authenticity discrepancies occurring within 30 days of confirmed delivery date.

OMS Invoice Vault Handwritten or unverified 3rd-party receipts. Serial / IMEI Barcode Matches serial logged during warehouse outbound scan.
